rule: A primary quarterback ruled OUT moves a price only through the engine's trained absence coefficient (football/cfb_p4 params injury.position_weight.QB). Each entry needs a source_url (an official team or conference availability report, or the program's own announcement), reported_at and recorded_by. scope 'rest_of_season' applies to every remaining game and postseason pairing of the team; scope 'games' only to the listed game_ids. Nothing else is priced and no return date is sampled.
